title: Cannot type the first character with accent in the search field of Kickoff due to search field not being focused by default
line: Accented letters typed with a compose key, dead key or input method right after opening Kickoff now keep their accent.
explanation: Kickoff opened with keyboard focus on the favorites grid and only forwarded typed key events to the search field. Qt's compose handling and input methods only process keys when a text field has focus, so the compose/dead key was dropped and the bare letter landed in the field ("e'" instead of "é"). The search field now takes focus when Kickoff opens. Until the user types, clicks the field or moves focus, it forwards keys first (Keys.BeforeItem) to the same views it already forwards to, so arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter and Menu act on the grid or list as before and move focus into it.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: focus the search field when opening

Compose keys and input methods only work in a focused text field, so the
first accented letter typed after opening Kickoff lost its accent. The
field now gets focus and passes navigation keys to the view first.

BUG: 459269
